title: Files tab — pictures or a list — contract

steps.path: The Files tab — its toolbar, the 'Project Files' line, and the files below
steps.headline: This is what done means.

rows.statement: The Files tab has two ways to look: the picture grid you have today, and a compact list.
The switch is on screen without opening any menu, and the view you are in is the marked one.
Each list row shows a small icon, the filename, its kind, and how long ago it changed.
The view you pick is remembered once for the whole app, so every project opens in it.
At phone width you keep the view you picked; neither view is forced on you.
The list gives one row per file, so a folder with many files is readable.
The search box keeps the shade it has today; only the tabs and the switch share theirs.
The switch sits small at the right end of the 'Project Files' line, off the toolbar.
At phone width the search box keeps its full width and the switch sits on the line below.
